description: Fetch data points for one or more Argentine government statistics time series by ID (up to 5 at once), with optional date range and frequency resampling (day/month/quarter/semester/year with avg/sum/end_of_period/min/max aggregation). Covers exchange rates, inflation, employment, and national accounts. Data: apis.datos.gob.ar/series (INDEC), no auth required.

collapse.description: Resample the series to this frequency (default: series native frequency).

collapse_aggregation.description: Aggregation method used when "collapse" resamples to a lower frequency (default: avg).

end_date.description: Restrict results to dates on/before this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

limit.description: Maximum number of data points to return (1-1000, default 100).

series_id.description: Series ID(s) to fetch, comma-separated for up to 5 series (e.g. "168.1_T_CAMBIOR_D_0_0_26"). Find IDs via search_series.

start_date.description: Restrict results to dates on/after this ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD).

name: indec-argentina.stats.get_series

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Get Argentina Statistics Series Data
